formNote: Mojidata IDS: ⿱中心. The Shuowen: 忠，敬也。从心，中聲 — “reverence: from heart, with 中 as phonetic.” Reading it as “a centred heart” treats the phonetic as meaning.
summary: Loyalty, but first doing one’s utmost for others: Zengzi said the Master’s whole way was 忠 and 恕, wholeheartedness and fellow-feeling. Later it hardened into loyalty to a ruler.
placement: On the falling side of the fold, facing 孝 across it. (Placement is a design choice, not a claim.)

oc.note: † Baracus, from general knowledge; not yet checked against B–S 2014.

satellites.title: Was I Loyal in Planning for Others?
satellites.evidence: Analects 1.4: Zengzi examines himself three times a day, and the first question is 為人謀而不忠乎 — “in planning for others, have I failed to give them my whole heart?” 忠 is wholeheartedness toward others before it is loyalty to a ruler.

satellites.title: The One Thread: Wholeheartedness and Reciprocity
satellites.evidence: Analects 4.15: Confucius says his way has one thread running through it, and Zengzi explains: 夫子之道，忠恕而已矣 — “the Master’s way is wholeheartedness and reciprocity, nothing more.”
